description: List, apply or remove source clip effects: effects on a clip project item itself (applied in the Source Monitor or Project panel), which every use of the clip in sequences inherits. Video effects only for apply. Applying and removing are one undo step each

component.description: For remove: component index from the list

effect.description: For apply: video effect match name or display name (from list_available_effects)

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

media.description: Which chain to list or remove from. Default video

name: manage_source_effects
title: Manage Source Effects
